reconstruction_summary: Re-ran the agent's V4 ridge residual learner (favourite) on all 545 canonical Ford segments: built per-platform V1->V3 (linear single-track with fit Cα + per-segment straight-line bias) using the agent's triage utilities, then trained Ridge(alpha=1.0) with leave-one-segment-out CV on features [v, |a_y|, |δ|, sign(δ̇)] against V3 residuals; V4 prediction = V3 prediction − LOSO residual correction.
notes: Agent's REPORT.md labels V4 best ('LOSO Ridge ... 0.01005 is genuine out-of-fold'). Agent saved no V4 model coefficients, so V4 was retrained on the full canonical set (both Mach-E and Lightning) under the same recipe; V3's Cα was refit per platform ({'FORD_MUSTANG_MACH_E_MK1': {'Cf_fit': 150000.0, 'Cr_fit': 150000.0, 'n_segs': 315}, 'FORD_F_150_LIGHTNING_MK1': {'Cf_fit': 150000.0, 'Cr_fit': 150000.0, 'n_segs': 230}}). LOSO holds out each of the 545 segments. Sample filter v_mps>2.0 matches the agent's V_MIN_ST fallback threshold for linear ST.
